name: section
title: Section
description: A titled block of a page, composed from Card: eyebrow, title at a heading level, description, top-end action, footer; card, bare or dashed (create tile) surfaces and sm or md padding.
docs: `<Section title="Members" action={<Button>Invite</Button>}>…</Section>` renders a `section` named by its title (an `h2` unless `headingLevel` says otherwise). `surface="none"` keeps the heading without a box, `surface="dashed"` is the outlined tile for creating something. `padding="sm"` tightens dense dashboards.
